doctrines.note: Veterancy: Topline (recommended) averages 1.68% heal/s, more offensive nodes, CD on bleed; Bot line averages 1.2% heal/s, more defensive nodes, more armor. Hero pairing: Any. Playstyle: don't charge in unless you have a lot of front-lane support (it will stack them); once in the fight, hold V to unlock the counter-attack stance; after pressing heal (2), cancel the animation with a V; unique bleed skill on units that damaged you recently — focus on taking aggro and activating it, and remember you can disengage and play around your healing; good tanking loop is Ironside doctrine into disengage into heal and repeat; Paladins are considered the best unit in the game for X+V cancel (V, then as soon as the damage pop-up shows, X-move and instantly V again, repeat) to raise DPS by cancelling most of the attack animation — only do this when free to DPS, since it stops blocking/counter-attack. Example build: Anti-Infantry Doctrine V (or an LS doctrine if available), Unit Damage Doctrine V, Iron Damage Doctrine V (Ironsides), Noble Blood Doctrine I, Siege Fighter Doctrine. "Origin", "Filler", and "Don't put" are literal X placeholders in the OP — not fabricated here. steps.text: Don't charge in unless you have plenty of front-lane support with you — charging alone will stack the enemy against you.
Once in the fight hold V for the counter-attack stance; after pressing heal (2), cancel the animation with V so the heal still lands.

X+V cancel: press V, then as soon as the damage pop-up appears, X-move and instantly V again, repeating to cancel most of the attack animation and raise DPS — only do this when free to DPS, since it forgoes blocking and counter-attack.
Unique bleed skill triggers on units that damaged you recently — focus on taking aggro and activating it; you can disengage and play around your own healing.
